basic_details.job_title: MSRLM Solapur Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 17 Block Anchor and Senior CRP Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Maharashtra State Rural Livelihoods Mission Solapur (MSRLM Solapur)
basic_details.short_information: Maharashtra State Rural Livelihoods Mission Solapur (MSRLM Solapur) Block Anchor and Senior CRP Notification 2026 has been released on the official website of Maharashtra State Rural Livelihoods Mission Solapur (MSRLM Solapur). A total of 17 vacancies have been announced through the MSRLM Solapur Block Anchor and Senior CRP Recruitment 2026.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 43 years for all posts. Age relaxation rules will be as per government norms.

qualification.education_qualification: Minimum Agriculture or allied degree such as BSC Agriculture with 1 year experience and computer knowledge, Minimum 12th pass with 3 years experience as Livelihood Sakhi under MSRLM
qualification.details: Block Anchor: Minimum Agriculture or allied degree such as Agriculture Technology, BSC Agriculture, BSC Horticulture, B.Tech Agriculture, BSC Fishery, BSC Forestry, BSC Veterinary, BSC Animal Husbandry, Bachelor of Business Administration with minimum 1 year experience and computer knowledge. Senior CRP: Minimum 12th pass, working or worked as Livelihood Sakhi under MSRLM mission such as Krishi Sakhi, Pashu Sakhi, M-CRP (Agriculture), Udyog Sakhi, Van Sakhi etc. with minimum 3 years experience.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for MSRLM Solapur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website:.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 07-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: MSRLM Solapur Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Block Anchor: Minimum Agriculture or allied degree such as Agriculture Technology, BSC Agriculture, BSC Horticulture, B.Tech Agriculture, BSC Fishery, BSC Forestry, BSC Veterinary, BSC Animal Husbandry, Bachelor of Business Administration with minimum 1 year experience and computer knowledge. Senior CRP: Minimum 12th pass, working or worked as Livelihood Sakhi under MSRLM mission such as Krishi Sakhi, Pashu Sakhi, M-CRP (Agriculture), Udyog Sakhi, Van Sakhi etc. with minimum 3 years experience.

content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 43 years for all posts. Age relaxation rules will be as per government norms.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MSRLM Solapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Block Anchor and Senior CRP posts is 07 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Block Anchor and Senior CRP posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 17 vacancies, with 5 for Block Anchor and 12 for Senior CRP.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Block Anchor post?
faq.answer: For the Block Anchor post, a minimum Agriculture or allied degree with 1 year of experience and computer knowledge is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for the Senior CRP post?
faq.answer: The Senior CRP post requires a minimum 12th pass with at least 3 years of experience as a Livelihood Sakhi under MSRLM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for both Block Anchor and Senior CRP posts is 43 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for MSRLM Solapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the Block Anchor and Senior CRP posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 7500/- per month for Senior CRP to Rs. 20000/- per month for Block Anchor.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply through the offline mode by sending their application form to the official address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for MSRLM Solapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application submission followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form details can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article.
